subject: Large CSV export times out
body: Our finance team has been pulling a large CSV export and it never finishes. It has hung for over 30 minutes on customer-export.csv. Anything above roughly 40000 rows just times out. We need this before month end.

subject: Slow dashboard load with many charts
body: Dashboards with more than about 10 charts take 15-20 seconds to load. It is slowing the team down.
resolution: Confirmed slow rendering above ~10 charts. Workaround: split into multiple dashboards.

subject: Large CSV export times out
body: Our finance team has been pulling a large CSV export and it never finishes. It has hung for over 20 minutes on customer-export.csv. Anything above roughly 40000 rows just times out. We need this before month end.
resolution: Confirmed timeout above ~50k rows. Workaround: use a scheduled export or narrow the date range. Tracked as ENG-4471; believed fixed in v2.3.

subject: Unexpected 429 from the Public API
body: Our integration suddenly gets HTTP 429 from the Public API though our volume is unchanged. What is the limit?
resolution: Documented limit is 120 requests/minute per token. Recommended exponential backoff.
